_comment: Spiritist skill+spell authoring set for the Battle Director engine. Specs are RAW-accurate (cross-checked against the world's existing Spiritist Items, which the GM authored from the Core rulebook). Each spec carries `class: 'Spiritist'` + `folder: 'Skill'` hints so CreateSkillFromSpec drops the new Item into `Battle Director / Spiritist / Skill`. Icons are reused from the existing world Items per the user's 'same-name icon' policy. CSB `Make item unique` (system.unique) defaults to TRUE for all Battle Director skills — a PC shouldn't end up with two copies of the same skill. Override with `spec.unique: false` only when stacking IS intended.

batch_1_shipped_2026-05-26: Heal (Spell; flat 40 HP × T, no roll — confirms 'no-Check spells' work)
Lux (Spell; HR+15 light damage to up to 3 — Ignis pattern with light element)
Reinforce (Spell; open_action_menu demo with 4 immunity AEs)

_open_action_menu_schema._doc: open_action_menu is an effect_kind that pauses the chain, shows a parchment picker of options, then dispatches the selected option's effect against the same ctx. Two equivalent author forms — pick whichever reads better for your skill. Passive ctx auto-picks option[0] (no prompt).
_open_action_menu_schema._form_a_refs: REFS FORM (CSB-friendly): menu_option_refs is a comma-separated list of effect_label values pointing at OTHER rows in the same effect_table. Each referenced row provides `menu_label` (+ optional `menu_description`) for display and its own `effect_kind` + params for dispatch. Mirrors `chain_steps`. Every option is a first-class effect_table row → fully visible + editable in the CSB sheet.
_open_action_menu_schema._form_b_inline: INLINE FORM (JSON-spec friendly): menu_options is an array of self-contained option objects, each with its own `effect_kind` + params + `label`/`description`. Compact — no separate rows needed. Used when authoring straight from JSON since the file stays small.
_open_action_menu_schema._priority: When both forms are present on the same row, REFS WIN — the CSB sheet's view of the data is authoritative for round-trip editing.

skills._raw: FU Core p.182 — Cost: 10×T MP. Targets: up to 3 creatures. Each target recovers 40 Hit Points. No roll. Skill Enhancement Lv. 20 → 50 HP, Lv. 40 → 60 HP.
skills._note: Flat HP heal × T, scales on caster's CHAR_LEVEL via tier formula `40 + (CHAR_LEVEL >= 20)*10 + (CHAR_LEVEL >= 40)*10`. recipe `heal_target` with target=action_targets fires on_activate (pre-damage). isCheck=false so no roll; CHAR_LEVEL identifier added to resolver (reads `actor.system.props.level`).

skills._raw: FU Core p.183 — Cost: 5×T MP. Targets: up to 3 creatures. Choose: Dazed / Shaken / Slow / Weak. Until this spell ends, each target is immune to the chosen status.
skills._note: open_action_menu demo authored in REFS FORM — each option is its own effect_table row (apply_ae) carrying menu_label + menu_description, and the menu row points at them via menu_option_refs. Both the menu config AND every option are fully visible/editable in the CSB sheet. Each option applies a 'Reinforce (status)' marker AE to all targets. The AE carries `flags.fabula-ultima-companion.reinforceImmunity: '<status>'` so a future immunity-check hook (B.2 or later) can read it and gate further status applications. For now, applying the AE is visible-only — the GM enforces immunity narratively until the hook lands.

skills._raw: FU Core p.182 — Cost: 5×T MP. Targets: up to 3 creatures. Each target recovers from 1 status effect. Homebrew (per the GM): removes 1 debuff of ANY type, not just the 6 named statuses (Slow / Dazed / Weak / Shaken / Enraged / Poisoned).
skills._note: B.1.4 reference demo for the `remove_tagged_ae` effect_kind. The picker is built at runtime from each target's AEs filtered by `system.tags.includes('debuff')`, so any AE the GM tags as 'debuff' is removable — fully extensible without touching this skill. Per-target picker (one prompt per cleansed creature), passive ctx auto-picks the first match. Cancel on a target's picker skips THAT target without aborting the rest of the cast.

skills._raw: FU Core p.183 — Cost: 10 MP. Offensive (lightning icon). Targets: One creature. The target must be hit by an INS+WLP Magic Check vs MDEF, then suffers Enraged and cannot perform Guard or Spell during their next turn.
skills._note: Offensive Spiritist Spell → INS+WLP Magic Check per [[offensive-spell-requires-check]]. Single target. apply_ae uses `target_ref: 'hit_action_targets'` so a miss applies nothing (still pays 10 MP).
skills._deferred_no_guard_no_spell_gate: RAW's 'cannot Guard or Spell next turn' clause needs the FSM to read the Enraged AE before letting the Guard/Spell command fire on the affected combatant's turn. Phase F (reaction/intent) gap — Enraged AE applies today, GM enforces the action restriction manually.

props.description: You cause a creature to lose any semblance of temper and act brazenly. The target hit by this spell (INS+WLP vs MDEF) suffers Enraged and cannot perform the Guard or Spell actions during their next turn.

skills._raw: FU Core p.182 — Cost: 20 MP. Targets: One creature. Duration: Scene. Choose Dexterity / Insight / Might / Willpower. Until the spell ends, the target treats the chosen Attribute as one die size higher (max d12).
skills._note: open_action_menu picks attribute → applies the matching common Buff-container AE (Swift / Awake / Strong / Focus) by bare name. Resolver's container-fallback (B.1.4 [[resolveAeTemplate]] step 3) finds them in the world's `Buff` container. The +2 modifier doesn't auto-clamp at d12 — GM avoidance handles RAW's max-d12 cap until B.2 adds capped-buff math.
skills._deferred_d12_cap: RAW caps die size at d12. AE applies +2 to <attr>_current unconditionally. B.2 may add a `cap_at_d12` flag or a 'capped-buff' effect_kind that no-ops if the target's attribute is already at the cap.
skills._attribute_to_ae_map: DEX→Swift, INS→Awake, MIG→Strong, WLP→Focus. These AEs are the same ones the RAW 'Buff' status uses (drops on hit per RAW). Awaken is RAW scene-duration, not drop-on-hit — the duration difference is a known gap (the common AE is reused for the buff math; semantic divergence handled narratively until B.2).

skills._raw: FU Core p.182 — Cost: 5×T MP. Targets: up to 3 creatures. Duration: Scene. Until the spell ends, each target may treat their Magic Defense as being equal to 12 against effects targeting them. (They keep their normal MDEF if higher than 12.)
skills._note: Floor mechanic: AE writes mode 4 (UPGRADE in this Foundry build) on the FINAL `magic_defense` key with value 12. Foundry's UPGRADE only writes if value > current — exactly the 'floor at 12' semantic. If CSB re-derives magic_defense after AE apply (clobbering the floor), fall back to writing to `bonus_magic_defense` with a delta formula.
skills._deferred_floor_semantics_test: Verify in-game that UPGRADE mode 4 on the FINAL `magic_defense` key sticks after CSB re-derives. Cast Aura on a creature with MDEF<12 and confirm MDEF reads 12.

props.description: You project your soul outside your body and direct it to surround the targets, shielding them from dangerous magic. Until this spell ends, each target may treat their Magic Defense as 12 against effects that target them (they keep their normal MDEF if higher).

activeEffects.name: Aura
activeEffects.description: Magic Defense floored at 12 — if the target's MDEF would be lower, it's treated as 12 instead. Normal MDEF still applies if higher.

skills._raw: FU Core p.182 — Cost: 5×T MP. Targets: up to 3 creatures. Duration: Scene. Until the spell ends, each target may treat their Defense as being equal to 12 against effects targeting them. (They keep their normal DEF if higher than 12.)
skills._note: Same shape as Aura but applied to `defense` (DEF) instead of `magic_defense` (MDEF). Mode 4 UPGRADE — only takes effect if the target's current DEF is below 12.
